programme.title: BizPodcast: What surprises foreign journalists most about China?
programme.desc: What surprises and impresses foreign journalists the most when they visit China? Which stories about China are they most eager to share with audiences back home? What expectations do they have for the upcoming China International Import Expo? Tune in to our podcast to discover their experiences, and hear fresh perspectives and untold stories from China!

programme.title: Land of Diversity
programme.desc: The power of evolution prevails even in some of the world's toughest environments. From mammals and reptiles to flowers and leafy plants, the Himalayas have some of the world's most diverse ecosystems, which have bred the most incredible diversity of life on the planet.

programme.title: Vive La Tech: Approaching the limits of temperature measurement
programme.desc: In this episode of CGTN's special program "Vive La Tech," we dive into the "frozen world". In low-temperature metrology, scientists created the world's most precise temperature measuring device, from 5 to 24.5 kelvin, providing a source for all thermometers around the world. Join CGTN reporter Yang Zhao to explore how such an innovative partnership can open new doors for fundamental science.

programme.title: Vive la Tech: Can nuclear energy create a greener future?
programme.desc: In this episode of "Vive La Tech," CGTN reporter Yang Zhao delves into the realm of nuclear energy to show how cooperation between China and France helps in tackling global challenges.

programme.title: Vive la Tech: Climate change is changing French wine
programme.desc: CGTN's new special program "Vive La Tech" focuses on some of the coolest science collaborations between China and France. In this episode, we shift our attention to climate change and the grape at risk. Follow our reporter Yang Zhao into the vineyards.

programme.title: One-stop global shopping at the CIIE - What's worth adding to your cart?
programme.desc: What global finds are worth adding to your cart? Come to Shanghai and go for a one-stop global shopping experience at the CIIE.

programme.title: Volkswagen aims 'In China, Beyond China'
programme.desc: Auto giant Volkswagen will bring China-developed intelligent and electrified technologies, and next-generation products to markets around the world. And China and Europe can join hands to drive the global auto transition. These are messages from Volkswagen Group CEO Oliver Blume at the #CIIE2026, as he sat down with Ralf Brandstätter, VW's China helm, for an exclusive interview with CGTN's Lily Lyu. The conversation spans tech innovation, China strategy and global auto outlook.

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions'
programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs may not be household names, but their smart manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive industrial support and resilient supply chains are a vital source of strength for China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry?

programme.title: KOLs and other ways to connect cultures
programme.desc: In what ways can KOLs better use their power in an age where a single video can reach millions? Tune in to #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions, and check out the stories of two KOLs from Ghana and Indonesia who use their creativity, empathy, and the shared desire to make people understand each other a little better.

programme.title: KOL traffic secrets: the power to drive change #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: How do creators build traffic on social media? How can that influence spark real changes in society? In a cozy siheyuan, the iconic Beijing courtyard, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions brings together two KOLs who open up about their journeys, their strategies, and the impact from their content. Click into the Behind the Scenes video to find out more!

programme.title: China's ocean economy at a turning point
programme.desc: Since elevating the goal of becoming a "maritime power" in 2012, China has made significant progress. What are the most eye-catching achievements? As the focus shifts from speed to quality, how could China's AI and digital tech edge help reshape the country's traditional maritime sectors? And in a system where a few countries still hold technological and narrative dominance, how can China gain a greater voice in rule-setting through global cooperation? Host TU Yun joins Yan Yan, a senior research fellow with the National Institute for South China Sea Studies, Qu Qiang, a professor and fellow of the Belt and Road Research Center at Minzu University of China, and Warwick Powell, an adjunct professor at Queensland University of Technology, to navigate the opportunities, challenges, and what lies beneath the surface.

programme.title: CIIE special: China's evolving role in the global market
programme.desc: As consumer demand and imports continue to expand, the Chinese market is becoming more than a sales destination - it is also a hub for business growth and innovation. During the 9th China International Import Expo (CIIE), CGTN's Vivienne Nunis talks with Manish Jain, regional general manager of IKEA China, and Krister Zackari, executive vice president at Fazer Group. They discuss the opportunities China offers global brands, how the market is shaping business strategies and supply chains, and the value of the CIIE for both returning exhibitors and first-time participants.

programme.title: China-US partnerships fueling rapid growth
programme.desc: Starbucks landed in China when coffee was a novelty. Today, 1 in 5 stores globally is there. American fast food and retail giants placed the same bet, and cashed in. Now local brands are out-executing them. The fix? Partner with Chinese private equity. Here's why it's working, and what it means for both sides.

programme.title: The green bridge between China & US
programme.desc: In 2019, Tesla was running on fumes. Shanghai handed it a lifeline, a gigafactory built in 10 months. Today, that plant produces nearly half of all Teslas using 95% local parts. That same playbook is expanding across green tech, pairing Chinese battery tech with American software. When the world's two largest economies build together, clean energy gets cheaper and faster for everyone.

programme.title: China-US: The efficiency advantage
programme.desc: The iPhone in your pocket? A global masterpiece. Apple's supply chain spans the world, with America's design expertise meeting China's manufacturing strength. Precision, speed and scale turn bold ideas into products in your hands. And this goes beyond Apple: cooperation across borders can drive innovation and growth. When the world's two biggest economies click, everyone benefits.

programme.title: Norway Salmon Fever
programme.desc: Norway's fjords and rivers are home to the iconic wild Atlantic salmon, but its population has fallen by half since the 1980s and now faces a growing threat from invasive Pacific pink salmon. Along the Tana River, locals have built traditional fish traps to intercept and manually sort the intruders, while new technology offers fresh hope in smaller rivers. Under its TECH4ALL initiative, Huawei, together with partners like the Berlevag Hunting and Fishing Association, has developed an AI-powered filtering system using underwater cameras, 5G, and solar power to identify fish with over 99% accuracy, diverting invasive salmon into holding tanks while letting native species pass freely. In 2023 alone, the system removed more than 6,000 pink salmon, cut manual labor by 90%, and avoided harm to native fish -- a model now set to scale across Norway and potentially worldwide.

programme.title: RAZOR: Sustainable Fishing Technology
programme.desc: Around 40% of marine life caught at sea are unintended species — a problem known as bycatch — which kills or discards an estimated 40 million tonnes of fish and threatens endangered animals such as dolphins, sea turtles and sharks. In this edition of RAZOR, Reya El-Salahi travels to western Scotland to meet fisherman Ian Wightman, who is trialling new high-tech gear designed to cut bycatch and boost his income. Created by SafetyNet Technologies, the devices combine cameras, sensors and lights that deter non-target species, while also collecting data on climate change and the impact of trawling on seabeds. At the company's London base in Somerset House, CTO Aran Dasan and his team refine the equipment with feedback from fishers to ensure it can survive the toughest ocean conditions — offering a glimpse of how technology could make commercial fishing more sustainable.

programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs may not be household names, but their smart manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive industrial support and resilient supply chains are a vital source of strength for China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry?

programme.title: KOLs and other ways to connect cultures
programme.desc: In what ways can KOLs better use their power in an age where a single video can reach millions? Tune in to #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions, and check out the stories of two KOLs from Ghana and Indonesia who use their creativity, empathy, and the shared desire to make people understand each other a little better.

programme.title: KOL traffic secrets: the power to drive change #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: How do creators build traffic on social media? How can that influence spark real changes in society? In a cozy siheyuan, the iconic Beijing courtyard, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions brings together two KOLs who open up about their journeys, their strategies, and the impact from their content. Click into the Behind the Scenes video to find out more!

programme.title: China's ocean economy at a turning point
programme.desc: Since elevating the goal of becoming a "maritime power" in 2012, China has made significant progress. What are the most eye-catching achievements? As the focus shifts from speed to quality, how could China's AI and digital tech edge help reshape the country's traditional maritime sectors? And in a system where a few countries still hold technological and narrative dominance, how can China gain a greater voice in rule-setting through global cooperation? Host TU Yun joins Yan Yan, a senior research fellow with the National Institute for South China Sea Studies, Qu Qiang, a professor and fellow of the Belt and Road Research Center at Minzu University of China, and Warwick Powell, an adjunct professor at Queensland University of Technology, to navigate the opportunities, challenges, and what lies beneath the surface.

programme.desc: Seventy years ago, the Canton Fair featured Chinese tea, silk and handmade goods. Today, it's about robots. Join us to see dexterous robotic hands, exoskeletons and companion robots, and how AI works alongside humans.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how? Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art. In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: China-US partnerships fueling rapid growth
programme.desc: Starbucks landed in China when coffee was a novelty. Today, 1 in 5 stores globally is there. American fast food and retail giants placed the same bet, and cashed in. Now local brands are out-executing them. The fix? Partner with Chinese private equity. Here's why it's working, and what it means for both sides.

programme.title: The green bridge between China & US
programme.desc: In 2019, Tesla was running on fumes. Shanghai handed it a lifeline, a gigafactory built in 10 months. Today, that plant produces nearly half of all Teslas using 95% local parts. That same playbook is expanding across green tech, pairing Chinese battery tech with American software. When the world's two largest economies build together, clean energy gets cheaper and faster for everyone.

programme.title: China-US: The efficiency advantage
programme.desc: The iPhone in your pocket? A global masterpiece. Apple's supply chain spans the world, with America's design expertise meeting China's manufacturing strength. When the world's two biggest economies click, everyone benefits.

programme.title: How can traditional craftsmanship stay relevant in a modern world?
programme.desc: In this story, designer Lan Yu explores how Su embroidery – one of China's most refined textile traditions – is evolving beyond preservation, and into contemporary fashion. From museum heritage to global runways, this is a story about culture, adaptation and reinvention.

programme.title: Journey of the Chili Pepper Ep.4
programme.desc: In China, the chili pepper is an indispensable winter ingredient. Since its arrival in the Ming dynasty, the spicy staple has been reshaping Chinese food culture. Today, as a new chili craze sweeps across the nation, we’ll take a look at how the chili evolved from a simple source of heat to a fiery cultural phenomenon.

programme.title: A Bite of China II Ep.1
programme.desc: In this much-anticipated sequel to the acclaimed foodie hit, we take an even closer look at the bond between Chinese people and food. Featuring around 150 characters and 300 different delicacies, we stand to witness to the role food plays in life's key moments. In short, this series offers the most flavorful insight into ancient Chinese culture that you are ever going to get!

programme.title: Gourmets Alive Ep.1
programme.desc: What did China's most celebrated scholars and poets eat? This documentary follows the trail of famous cultural figures from ancient to modern times, using reenactments to explore the classic dishes that helped define China’s rich culinary history.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: The Qibao Ancient Town
programme.desc: Pudong reflects the changes of Shanghai over the past ten years, the Bund represents Shanghai's hundred‑year history, and Qibao Ancient Town bears witness to Shanghai's thousand years of vicissitudes. To support the publicity for the first China International Import Expo in Shanghai, we come to Qibao Ancient Town, a rare surviving ancient town within Shanghai's urban area, close to Hongqiao Airport and the site of the Import Expo. We recommend this destination for short‑term travellers. Transportation here is very convenient, and you can experience the charm of traditional Shanghai.

programme.title: Fearless Journey Ep.1
programme.desc: Ten outdoor enthusiasts take on the world through various sports ---- from marathons to cycling ---- experiencing geography, culture, history, and the spirit of athletics.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But there's more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan's narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you'll encounter one of China's most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What's life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we're embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people's most important rituals: the coming of age ceremony.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.1
programme.desc: Yunnan straddles the Hengduan Mountains and Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, revealing Kawagarbo Peak, vibrant Lijiang, and Hani's golden terraces. Come fly with us on a quest for the essence of Yunnan and discover why it so richly deserves its name - Yunnan, 'the Land South of the Clouds'!

programme.title: Chinese for a Day | intro
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Shanxi Province, one of the birthplaces of Chinese civilization. Jack and Jonathan discover 4,000-year-old artifacts and explore how ancient Chinese people used astronomy to mark the seasons, uncovering the wisdom and traditions of an ancient civilization.

From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: The Qibao Ancient Town
programme.desc: Pudong reflects the changes of Shanghai over the past ten years, the Bund represents Shanghai's hundred‑year history, and Qibao Ancient Town bears witness to Shanghai's thousand years of vicissitudes. To support the publicity for the first China International Import Expo in Shanghai, we come to Qibao Ancient Town, a rare surviving ancient town within Shanghai's urban area, close to Hongqiao Airport and the site of the Import Expo. We recommend this destination for short‑term travellers. Transportation here is very convenient, and you can experience the charm of traditional Shanghai.

programme.title: Fearless Journey Ep.1
programme.desc: Ten outdoor enthusiasts take on the world through various sports ---- from marathons to cycling ---- experiencing geography, culture, history, and the spirit of athletics.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But there's more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan's narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you'll encounter one of China's most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What's life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we're embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people's most important rituals: the coming of age ceremony.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: Speed Asesino
programme.desc: Dos mejores amigos utilizan aviones de alta tecnología construidos por ellos mismos para llevar droga de México a California y financiar así su estilo de vida en Hollywood.

programme.title: Exoplaneta Dune en Peligro
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: Battledogs
programme.desc: Un virus de hombre lobo se desata sobre Nueva York, y el Mayor Hoffman busca una cura mientras el Teniente General Monning quiere establecer un nuevo ejército canino.

programme.title: Breach
programme.desc: A punto de convertirse en padre, un joven mecánico a bordo de un arca interestelar rumbo a la Nueva Tierra debe ingeniárselas para vencer a un terror cósmico maligno que pretende usar la nave espacial como arma.

programme.title: Bus Driver
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar que se dirige a un retiro sufre un pinchazo y se detiene en el rancho más cercano en busca de ayuda. El conductor, cinco estudiantes problemáticos y su ridículo profesor de gimnasia como acompañante se encuentran, en cambio, con criminales dispuestos a todo para que sus operaciones de drogas no sean descubiertas. Los estudiantes y el profesor son presas fáciles para estos delincuentes, pero entre ellos y una muerte segura se interpone una fuerza más decidida y hábil de lo que jamás imaginaron: el conductor del autobús.

programme.title: Bloody Hell
programme.desc: Durante un asalto a un banco, Rex, un tipo que suele hablar consigo mismo o con su conciencia, detiene a los asaltantes y, tras varios disparos, logra asegurar todo el establecimiento; pero, desafortunadamente, toda la misión, a pesar de haber sido un éxito, termina de manera trágica, por lo que es juzgado y encarcelado. Tras cumplir su condena, se muda a Finlandia para tomarse un respiro, pero termina atrapado por una retorcida familia caníbal que esconde un secreto muy oscuro.

programme.title: Piel
programme.desc: Un notorio skinhead se enamora de una mujer y sus tres hijas, y se somete a dolorosos tratamientos para eliminar los tatuajes que cubren todo su rostro y cuerpo, la representación física del odio que mostró al mundo durante más de la mitad de su vida. Basada en la historia real de Bryon Widner.

programme.title: Tomb Invader
programme.desc: La arqueóloga Alabama Channing es reclutada por un misterioso multimillonario para que le ayude a encontrar una antigua reliquia china. El mismo tesoro que buscaba su madre antes de desaparecer.

programme.title: Kill 'Em All
programme.desc: Tras un tiroteo masivo, un misterioso desconocido (Van Damme) llega a un hospital local al borde de la muerte. Entonces, una banda extranjera se presenta descaradamente al hospital para cazarlo. Su enfermera, la única testigo superviviente del tiroteo posterior, debe enfrentarse a un interrogatorio del FBI que desvela una trama de intriga y venganza internacional. Con suficientes giros inesperados, KILL'EM ALL te mantendrá en vilo hasta el último disparo.

programme.title: Santos y soldados
programme.desc: Cuatro soldados estadounidenses y un británico durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial luchan por regresar al territorio aliado después de ser separados de las fuerzas estadounidenses durante la histórica Masacre de Malmedy.

programme.title: Yatterman
programme.desc: La hermosa y ultra sexy Doronjo y sus malvados esbirros, sedientos de dinero, fama y poder, intentan recuperar los pedazos de una legendaria piedra con poderes misteriosos. Pero sus planes se verán interrumpidos por Gan, Ai y su fiel perro robot gigante, quienes iniciarán una frenética carrera contrarreloj para impedir que la gema caiga en manos de los villanos.

programme.desc: Jack Tyson es un joven que participa en una carrera automovilística ilegal de México a California cuando una mujer desesperada, que huye de su abusivo novio gánster que financia el torneo, se sube a su coche pidiendo su ayuda y tiene una unidad USB incriminatoria que podría enviar a su novio matón, entre otros, a prisión.

programme.title: Asalto a Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim, un neoyorquino corriente, vive con una esposa enferma pero cariñosa. De repente, todo cambia cuando la economía se hunde y lo pierde todo. Lleno de ira y rabia, Jim se propone vengarse de la vida que le han arrebatado.

programme.title: 12 horas
programme.desc: Sigue un juego de supervivencia en un mundo virtual similar a Matrix, enfrentando varios desafíos, incluido un monstruo aterrador.

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: El agresor
programme.desc: Sasha Mitchell (Kickboxer 2 y 3) regresa triunfalmente al ring como David Sloan, luchando no solo por su supervivencia, sino también por su bella esposa, quien se ha convertido en la prisionera sexual del despreciable campeón mundial, Tong Po. Incriminado, olvidado y furioso, Sloan se ha consumido en prisión, pero los federales acceden a liberarlo si logra entrar en la impenetrable fortaleza mexicana de Tong Po, protegida por sus letales guardias y adornada por sus esclavas sexuales. Sloan no tiene más remedio que participar en el torneo de campeones de Po, una batalla salvaje donde el ganador se lo lleva todo, ¡y para Sloan eso significa todo! A regañadientes, forma alianzas con algunos otros para ayudarlo.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio en Los Ángeles y luego uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.desc: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, los alemanes deciden lanzar una última gran ofensiva. Al teniente Robert Cappa y su pelotón se les asigna la responsabilidad de defender un depósito de suministros vital.

programme.title: A través del ojo
programme.desc: 1976 es un año peligroso en el estrecho de Yucatán. Jack Hooks, un ex policía traicionado por su socio corrupto, es enviado a la cárcel por un delito relacionado con drogas que no cometió. Tras salir de prisión gracias a un acuerdo de libertad anticipada ofrecido por la DEA, se le asigna una misión de vida o muerte para acabar con el tráfico de drogas de su antiguo socio Frank Rossi y sus contactos.

programme.title: Top Gunner
programme.desc: Los graduados de una remota base de las Fuerzas Aéreas estadounidenses deben proteger un arma biológica de edición genética de los militares rusos, que están desesperados por hacerse con el agente vírico a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Problemas en el Paraiso
programme.desc: Rachel, una reciente viuda, viaja de regreso a Estados Unidos en un barco de carga con el cuerpo de su esposo cuando el barco naufraga en una isla desierta. Solo hay otro sobreviviente y ambos están decididos a ser rescatados. Tras una serie de eventos extremos, finalmente son encontrados, pero por su esposo, quien había fingido su muerte.

programme.title: Asesino de tiburones
programme.desc: Los servicios del asesino de tiburones Chase Walker han sido contratados por su hermano Jake, jefe de una banda criminal de la Costa Oeste. El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: H4zard
programme.desc: Sigue a Noah, quien realmente ama a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero después de aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que podría costarle la vida, su familia o su querido automóvil.

programme.desc: Un joven científico llega a un pequeño pueblo pesquero para luchar contra la criatura que vive bajo el agua.

programme.title: Arenas movedizas
programme.desc: En este thriller negro, un banquero de carácter introvertido y trabajador se ve envuelto en una serie de eventos que incluyen un asesinato y una trama de chantaje, todo mientras intenta mantener su vida en orden.

programme.title: Dracula The Original Living Vampire V2
programme.desc: La detective Amelia Van Helsing busca al asesino responsable de una serie de espantosos asesinatos de mujeres jóvenes. Las cosas empeoran cuando todas las pruebas apuntan al aparentemente intocable Conde Drácula.

programme.title: Silencio
programme.desc: Silencio de Martin Scorsese cuenta la historia de dos misioneros que viajan a Japón en búsqueda de su mentor desaparecido en un momento en que el cristianismo estaba prohibido. Cuando son capturados, ambos hombres se sumergen en una peligrosa odisea.

programme.title: Una osa llamada Winnie
programme.desc: La extraordinaria historia real del oso negro que se convertiría en la inspiración para las historias de A.A. Milne, y el hombre heroico que le salvó la vida.

programme.title: Atrápame si puedes
programme.desc: Dirigida por Steven Spielberg y protagonizada por Leonardo DiCaprio y Tom Hanks, narra la historia real de Frank Abagnale Jr., quien antes de los 19 años estafó millones haciéndose pasar por piloto, médico y fiscal.

programme.title: El bufete
programme.desc: Mitch es un abogado atraído por una gran firma con la promesa de un futuro brillante. Las cosas no salen según lo planeado después de que se ve envuelto en un caso de asesinato.

programme.title: Fuera de control

programme.title: Llena tu día de Dios

programme.title: CSI

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A roller coaster runs off its track, leaving six people dead. The CSI team investigates whether this was an accident or foul play.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Two young men are found murdered after scamming Sam Braun's casinos.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A casino employee is beaten and raped on her way home from work, but she survives and identifies her attacker.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: While Grissom leads a group of college students on a tour of CSI, the dead speak while the CSIs investigate, each narrating their own case

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: The CSIs investigate first-hand the behind-the-scenes action of Cirque du Soleil in order to determine what may have contributed to a young dancer's untimely death.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom is fascinated when every detail of a miniature is identical to that of a real crime scene, and he goes about trying to solve the case using the clues provided.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When an innocent man is brutally attacked and beaten to death by what looks like a monster in a black cape, the CSIs are called to investigate, only to learn that a similar attack took place minutes later.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When a dead woman is found hanging from a cross inside a church, the team follows the evidence to uncover a bizarre love triangle dating all the way back to the victim's high school days.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When two young boys are reported missing, a known neighborhood sex offender is the primary suspect.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When identical twins are found dead, the evidence in both cases does not immediately prove a connection between the two deaths. However, as the CSIs dig deeper into the histories of the women, a surprising twist takes the investigation in a new direction.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and his team investigate a string of murders in Las Vegas that may be tied to an infamous mob boss from the 1970s who disappeared many years ago.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When the CSIs process clues after a murder at a poultry manufacturing plant, the evidence leads them to the home of a man who collects miniature trains and other miniature paraphernalia.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El testimonio de Catherine ante el tribunal no es suficiente para condenar a un asesino sospechoso de asesinar a su propia madre.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El principal sospechoso del sonado asesinato del asambleísta Danilo Zamesca es Thomas Simon, el mayor proveedor de drogas de la costa oeste.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Cuando Catherine y Keppler comienzan a investigar el asesinato de una desconocida adolescente, ambos coinciden en que el asesino, que fue meticuloso a la hora de eliminar pruebas del cadáver y sus alrededores, es probablemente reincidente.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Un caso relacionado con el cadáver calcinado de un hombre cuyos huesos y tejidos habían sido extraídos lleva a Nick y Keppler al inquietante mundo de la venta ilegal de partes de cuerpos humanos.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom regresa de su año sabático como profesor mientras el nuevo miembro del equipo Michael Keppler intenta desesperadamente mantener su oscuro pasado oculto a sus colegas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Con potencialmente menos de un día para intentar evitar los próximos asesinatos, el equipo de CSI debe sacudirse rápidamente la sorpresa de que el verdadero asesino en miniatura no es el difunto Ernie Edward Dell.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: La ocurrencia de Grissom de que dos jóvenes amantes desaparecidos pueden haber huido a México queda pronto anulada por el descubrimiento de gotas de sangre junto a la plaza de aparcamiento libre del chico en el instituto.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Mientras procesa la casa donde fueron asesinadas varias coristas, Sara se ve atormentada por los ojos aterrorizados y las crípticas palabras moribundas de la sexta víctima que descubre.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Greg se ve obligado a enfrentarse de nuevo a la hostil madre y al hermano del matón al que mató en defensa propia hace varios meses cuando el equipo de CSI descubre que el hermano está implicado en un nuevo caso de asesinato.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Mientras Grissom y el resto de los CSI están fuera investigando nuevos casos, Hodges hace creer a Archie, Henry, Mandy y Wendy que Grissom quiere que se unan en secreto esa noche para intentar resolver los cuatro casos de asesinos en miniatura.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: En su intento por identificar al asesino de un ex boxeador que vivía entre un grupo de prostitutas que lo detestaban, los CSI deben establecer cuál de los varios actos que pusieron en peligro su vida en una noche realmente lo mató.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El equipo de CSI investiga el asesinato de una crupier de blackjack cuyo marido, separado de ella, tiene vínculos con un club de creyentes en los ovnis.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.sub-title: El bueno, el feo y la dominatriz
programme.desc: A Sara le inquieta que Grissom se reúna con Lady Heather durante la investigación de los CSI sobre su intento de asesinato por parte de un cliente al que se niega a nombrar.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Mientras el equipo de CSI se acerca más que nunca a la identificación del asesino en miniatura, Sara desaparece misteriosamente, lo que obliga a sacar a la luz su relación con Grissom.

programme.desc: Deadly Women are not always the ones you expect. They are not the strangers lurking in the dark, they are a young mother, a supportive wife and a grandmother - all killers. Behind their loving masquerade lies a wake of family horror and pain.

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women: A Daughter's Revenge
programme.desc: Every day, teenage girls are being scolded by their parents, only to respond with tears and slammed bedroom doors. Some daughters won’t take "no" for an answer, and these girls become deadly.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Baby-Faced Killers
programme.desc: These baby-faced girls may look childish and innocent, but behind their little girl smiles lies a darkness most adults never experience. When their inner turmoil bubbles to the surface, they become unlikely criminals.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Love and desire are powerful currents that surge through human affairs. When they run off course, the results can be deadly.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes the innocence of childhood is swept away by dark thoughts and violent currents. Deep and disturbing psychological impulses will drive a child to kill another child.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Sacrifice Their Blood
programme.desc: To the outside world these caring mothers present a face of love - a suburban Mom, a caring community member, a housewife - but when the doors close, these deadly women will do whatever it takes to have their own needs met, even destroy their family.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Some killers are so troubled that their actions are almost impossible to comprehend. Welcome to the shadow land of the insane and psychopathic as we enter the haunting world of the disturbed.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Dog Is Smokin'
programme.desc: Dog is trying to cut down on smoking, but it's not easy with his high-stress job. Today, he must track down Walter, a fugitive who believes that the Canadian military has planted a chip in his tooth that allows him to communicate with his van.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: You Snooze, You Lose
programme.desc: Beth designs a luxurious new office for the team and shows it off to Dog, but the bounty hunter is more interested in starting his hunt for Federico, who's been revoked for missing court dates and generally running amuck.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Judgment Day
programme.desc: Dog goes on his a case, which involves Bobby, who's been on parole for three months pending sentencing on an assault charge. Bobby's girlfriend wants him back in jail, and Dog agrees that the Bobby needs to be behind bars.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Moms & Dads
programme.desc: Dog pursues two people whose lives have been ruined by drugs. First, he tracks Mae, who traded a good home and loving family for an ice pipe. The next case involves Jude. His addiction has caused his pregnant wife to fear for her safety.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Do Unto Others
programme.desc: Dog is a rough, tough bounty hunter, but he's a softie at heart, as the two cases in this episode show.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Helping Hand
programme.desc: Dog answers two very different calls for help from women. In the first case, he helps Leland protect Maria, who's being threatened by her violent husband. Then Dog visit a young woman who's dying and has asked to see Dog as one of her final wishes.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
programme.sub-title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
programme.desc: Baby Lyssa, who's just turned 18 and is studying to become a bondsman, gets to do some on-the-job training when she helps Dog hunt for Wayne, who's run out on a bond for second-degree assault.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: In Sickness and In Health
programme.desc: Dog is sick as a dog, but he still must lead the hunt for a fugitive named James. James' girlfriend tries to cover for him, but Dog surprises James in his bedroom and leads him away in cuffs.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: If the Shirt Fits...
programme.desc: Beth buys Dog a shirt with an embroidered chicken, but Dog explains he only wears shirts with pictures of either Jesus or a Harley-Davidson. When it's time to go to work, the team goes after Necia, a fugitive with felony charges pending.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Thief Who Stole Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas day, and Dog sets out to nab Raymond, who robs to support his ice habit, and give him a little Christmas gift - shiny new handcuffs.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rock-a-Bye Bounty
programme.desc: Dog and Beth must go after their former housekeeper, Lisa, who's jumped bond. They know this case will be tricky because Lisa knows everyone in the family. Luckily, Beth's nephew, Jason, is visiting and is quickly put to work as the bait.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Father-Hood
programme.desc: Before Tim heads out for a tough day of bounty hunting, he likes to get in a little quality time with his daughter, Summer Rain.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cops and Criminals
programme.desc: After giving a rousing speech to an audience of enthusiastic grade-schoolers, Dog catches up with an old friend, Sheriff Tommy Cayetano, to talk business. Dog's got a tough fugitive, named Mia, to catch and Tommy is happy to lend a hand.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cupid in Cuffs
programme.desc: It's the day before Valentine's Day and love is in the air at Da Kine Bail Bonds--but not for Tapi who has failed to appear in court on theft charges. Dog's plan is to have Leland knock on Tapi's door with a Valentine's gift to draw her out.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bonds of Love
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are finally getting married! They've been together for more than ten years but Dog is determined, as he puts it, to "marry his common law wife the Christian way."

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: To Love and to Cherish
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are off to the Big Island for their wedding. They hope to relax for a few days but it turns out Leland has a fugitive he needs to catch and despite the time limit, neither Dog nor Beth can resist the opportunity to catch a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bustin' with Justin
programme.desc: Dog and the team must deal with misleading informants, belligerent boaters, and angry drunks when they go after Kimberly, a traffic offender with over 20 violations. And if that isn't enough, Dog has another problem - Duane Lee is sick.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Run Fugitive, Run
programme.desc: When the team hunts for Steven, a fugitive with a history of domestic abuse, they seek help from his girlfriend, who's been a victim of his abuse. Meanwhile, Beth trains for a 5K race to help raise awareness about domestic abuse.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Vegas or Bust
programme.desc: Dog is going to be the keynote speaker at the annual Profession Bail Agents convention in Las Vegas, but before he leaves he's got to clear two cases from his docket - Heidi and Stephanie.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Playing Possum
programme.desc: Tim's got a big problem. Owen has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen. With Dog's help he tries to track down the co-signer but they come up dry.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rainy Day Woman
programme.desc: It's been raining for days and the team is going a little stir crazy, but Dog has the cure; a good hunt. Maui has failed to appear on a drug charge and the team has just one lead. She was recently spotted during a bust at a local chop shop garage.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ticket to Ride
programme.desc: Dog decides it's time to outfit the Da Kine crew with new SUVs. After a quick visit to their local dealership, they go after Jasmine, a woman whose criminal record includes over 37 arrests for everything from drug promotion to assault.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mother Knows Best
programme.desc: Dog has two fugitives to catch, and he gets help from the unlikeliest sources - the fugitives' mothers. First, Ginger's mother wants to revoke her daughter's bond. Then, Brandon's mother decides to revoke his bond because Brandon has an ice habit.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Irons in the Fire

Mark Christopher Lawrence
programme.desc: Mark Christopher Lawrence (born May 22, 1964) is an American character actor, stand-up comedian, and voice-over artist. He is perhaps best known for his role as esoteric D.J., Tone Deaf, in the 1994 satirical rap mockumentary, Fear of a Black Hat. He has co-starred in popular films such as Terminator 2: Judgment Day, Planet of the Apes, Lost Treasure and The Pursuit of Happiness. Lawrence can currently be seen in his regular role as Big Mike on the NBC series Chuck. He has made guest appearances on many television programs, most notably Heroes, My Name Is Earl, Crossing Jordan, Dharma & Greg, Malcolm in the Middle, Touched by an Angel, Malcolm & Eddie, Men Behaving Badly, Seinfeld, Murphy Brown, and Martin. He is also featured on the Radio Series Adventures in Odyssey as "Ed Washington".

programme.title: Bengt Washburn
programme.desc: Bengt Washburn is an Aquarius with Hazel eyes who prefers boxer briefs, solid deodorants, and Crest toothpaste. He is 5'9? tall, weighs about 149 pounds and can bench 150 pounds three times without a spotter. He has a vertical leap of 16 inches. 8 years ago a lump appeared on his right thigh. It's not visible from the stage but according to some kids at the water park, it looks creepy. Many people say Bengt looks kind of like a monkey. Bengt Washburn was born in Salt Lake City, Utah but grew up in a large Utah town (1,200 people) as the fifth child in a small Mormon family (7 children). Bengt is married to an officer in the United States Airforce. They have lived in 6 different cities over the last eleven years. Most recently he moved to Springfield, Virginia (Washington D.C.) after living in Stuttgart, Germany for 3 years. Bengt is a former winner of the prestigious San Francisco International Comedy Competition. He has been seen on The Late Late Show with Craig Fergusen, Live at Gotham on Comedy Central and most recently Conan on TBS. He was invited to perform at the Vancouver International Comedy Festival, The Boston Comedy Festival, the Aspen Laff Festival and Gilda's Laugh Fest in Grand Rapids, Michigan. He's been heard on NPR, PRI and Bob and Tom. All three of his comedy Cd's can be heard playing on XM Sirius radio. Most people who know him would say Bengt is a logistically impaired ditz, but his comedy is described as intelligent, surprisingly universal considering the content matter and profoundly funny.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Flock and Key
programme.desc: Si recruits his nephews to help him transport a storage container to his backyard, but things take a turn when Jep becomes locked inside the box. Meanwhile, Jase helps Mia prepare for her cheerleading competition, but the only problem is he has no idea.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Ball in the Family
programme.desc: When Willie's old rival Phillip McMillan challenges him to a game of dodgeball, Willie recruits his family members to settle a score once and for all. Meanwhile, Si thinks his cat is cheating on him with another family, so he recruits Miss Kay.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Drone Survivor
programme.desc: When Jase and Phil make a bet about whether or not human beings in a duck blind are visible from the air, Jep buys a drone copter to get a "bird's eye" view, but ends up losing it in the process.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Alan in Charge
programme.desc: Jase and the guys convince Willie to hire his older brother Alan to work at Duck Commander, but when Alan begins micromanaging everyone, they quickly change their mind. Meanwhile, the ladies take a self-defense class and use John Luke as a punching bag.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Renaissance Men
programme.desc: When the Robertsons throw a Renaissance Fair birthday party for Godwin, various family members compete in a tournament to win knighthood.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Heroes Welcome
programme.desc: In this special episode, the Duck Commander team surprises two wounded veterans with a trip to Monroe so they can be in an episode of Duck Dynasty. To show their support, the Robertson family stages a color run to bring awareness to our wounded soldiers.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Pie Hard
programme.desc: Willie and Alan agree to help Miss Kay open her own bakery, but things take a turn when Kay is asked to hand over her secret recipes. Meanwhile, the guys in the duck call room take an extended lunch break by driving to Mississippi.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Van He'llsing
programme.desc: When Missy and Jase's son Reed purchases an old van to boost his music career, his parents begin to question some of his choices. Meanwhile, Willie helps Jep prepare River for a competitive wrestling league by introducing him to his friend.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Toad to Perdition
programme.desc: When Willie and his brothers spend too much time frog hunting, their wives challenge them to a "frogging" competition.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: RV There Yet?
programme.desc: The Robertson family takes a road trip to Liberty University where they will drop off John Luke and Mary Kate for their first year of college. Along the way, they stop in Nashville to visit Willie's friend Colt Ford.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Willie & Korie's Anniversorry
programme.desc: The Robertson family throws a party for Willie & Korie's 25th anniversary, but things take a dramatic turn when Willie and Korie reveal a big secret. Meanwhile, when Jase blames Uncle Si for getting him a parking ticket.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Statue of Imitations
programme.desc: When Willie asks a local chainsaw artist to make him a statue, he gets a big surprise when it's revealed that the statue is of an unlikely subject - Willie himself. Meanwhile, Jep and Jessica attempt to help Kay with her hoarding.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: A Decent Proposal
programme.desc: On a trip to New York, Jase's son Reed proposes to his girlfriend, which inspires his father to fan the flames of romance back home with Missy. Meanwhile, Sadie asks Willie to be a guest lecturer at her business class.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Father Knows Pest
programme.desc: The tables are turned when the HOA comes to Jase for help to rid the neighborhood of a menacing beaver. Little Will has just gotten his learner's permit, and Willie and Si argue over which of them is the better driving instructor.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Wild Wild West Monroe
programme.desc: When Jase and Jep get into an argument over which of them is the rightful heir to their grandfather's old rifle, they decide to settle the argument with a marksmanship contest. Meanwhile, Willie and Korie help Rebecca prepare for her trip to Taiwan.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Half in the Bag
programme.desc: After Si has started moonlighting as a grocery bagger, the guys show up at the store and their teasing inadvertently causes Si to lose his job and his chance to enter a local bagging competition.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: There Will Be Flood
programme.desc: When a large storm hits Monroe, most of the adults head to Phil and Kay's to help protect their house from flooding while Jess, Sadie, Rebecca and Cole babysit the kids. Meanwhile, Jep, Si, Martin and Godwin try to protect the Duck Commander.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bingo Star
programme.desc: Willie accompanies Kay to a local bingo tournament and gets seduced by the game, eventually embarrassing himself and Kay with his enthusiasm.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Sadie's Choice
programme.desc: Willie takes Sadie on a tour of a local college in hopes of convincing her to stay nearby after her impending high school graduation.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Children of the Cornbread
programme.desc: When the Robertson brothers debate which of their wives makes the best cornbread, it escalates into a full-on cornbread cook off. Meanwhile, when Jep, Martin, and Godwin play a practical joke on Uncle Si, it ends up being Si who has the last laugh.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Whole Lotta Bull
programme.desc: The guys enjoy a one-day rodeo fantasy camp where they learn the ins and outs of riding, roping and clowning.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Here Comes the Son
programme.desc: After leaving school to pursue music, Jase feels that Reed needs some structure in his life, so he hires him to take his place at Duck Commander.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bro'd Trip
programme.desc: Jase accompanies Willie on a business trip to Arkansas to pitch a new product and has unorthodox sales strategies. Back in Monroe, Jep and Si have to track down an important item of Willie's that they accidentally shipped out.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Willie thinks his kids have been spending too much time on their phones and other devices so he initiates a "No-Tech Week," but when he has to participate too it ends up being harder than he thought. There's a lice outbreak at Duck Command.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The West Monroe Wing
programme.desc: Willie and Jase run against each other to become president of their neighborhood HOA. Jep, Jess and Miss Kay work on a Duck Commander themed display for the local zoo.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Automation Frustration
programme.desc: Willie buys a 3D printer for the office that starts off as a fun distraction for the guys until it appears the printer could soon replace their jobs. Si is upset that Willie invested in the 3D printer and didn't give him a raise.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Razing the Snakes
programme.desc: Jase, Jep, Si and Cole try to fight back a growing population of cottonmouth snakes on Phil's property. Meanwhile, Willie uses his business expertise to help Rebecca improve her clothing store.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Uneasy Rider
programme.desc: Willie puts Little Will on a budget for his first car but it backfires when Will decides to get a motorcycle instead. Jase and the guys are inspired to design a product using zip lines that will revolutionize duck hunting.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Good Willie Hunting
programme.desc: While many of the guys' wives and children are in Africa doing charity work, Willie and Jase get into a debate over tracking ability which leads to a challenge--can Jase and Si track and capture Willie and Jep?

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Sleep Cover
programme.desc: With Korie still in Africa, Willie and Jep must step in and supervise Bella's sleepover. When a couple boys play a prank on the girls, Willie and Jep prove to be the perfect chaperones for the task.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Drive-In Revivin'
programme.desc: Korie challenges Willie to come up with a romantic gesture without spending any money. Missy and Jase compete to see who can find a girlfriend for Mountain Man.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Fishful Thinking
programme.desc: Jase's hopes to win the inaugural Duck Commander Fishing Tournament is buoyed when he is able to enlist the help of legendary angler Bill Dance. Meanwhile, Willie's vanity over his greying beard leads him to make a questionable decision.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: When Doves Fry
programme.desc: Jase and Jep make a deal with Mia and Merritt to get them to go dove hunting with them. Si tries to make some extra cash by starting a West Monroe tour.

Remedios (Cristina Peña), la prima de Paz (Melanie Olivares), viene de visita y habrá que ocultarle la profesión de su prima. Luisma (Paco León) intenta conquista a la guapa y puritana prima de Paz.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) quiere impresionar a los nuevos vecinos que se han instalado en su edificio, pero la tarea no va bien y acaba teniendo un problema con el padre de la familia. Luisma (Paco León) anima a Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) a que se presente a un concurso de televisión y demostrar sus artes en la música y el baile. Mauricio (Mariano Peña) decide irse de su casa tras discutir con su madre. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) lo acoge en su hogar pero no tardará en arrepentirse

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Mauricio ha vislumbrado una nueva posibilidad de negocio tras enterarse, por medio de Acon y Machu, que alguien ha encontrado una cartera con un cheque muy suculento. Mauricio cree que puede hacerse pasar por el propietario, un ruso llamado Vasily Gayvoronyuk, y engañar a la mujer que ha encontrado la billetera. Tras enterarse que el ruso es calvo decide que tal vez si le rapa la cabeza a Aconcagua pueda conseguir un parecido más razonable. El resultado es espantoso hasta que Simón le comenta que a lo mejor Chema sí que podría pasar por el ruso...

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Soraya descubre que se parece mucho a Graciela, una actriz de telenovela venezolana, y desde entonces se hace adicta al culebrón y comienza a comportarse como ella. Chema está molesto porque su novia ya no es ella misma. Por otro lado, Macu le plantea a su novio que tengan una relación abierta para poder estar con otras personas y Mauricio olvida el aniversario de la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Riesgo quiere vengarse de Mauricio y para ello secuestra a su madre. Mauricio desesperado acude al propio Riesgo que al verle cree que ha sido descubierto y huye. Paz y Simón se van a Londres, tienen todo preparado pero ella rompe los billetes al darse cuenta de que Luisma no ha leído su carta. Jonathan se ha quemado en las manos y necesita ayuda con las tareas cotidianas. Su madre no acepta pero sí acude Fidel en su rescate.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una luna de miel, un terreno rústico urbanizable y un presidente en remojo
programme.desc: Tras haber sido desahuciado del bajo A por Maite, y tras el inesperado regreso de su hermano Teodoro a la comunidad, Amador busca un piso para vivir junto a su hermano. Por lo que, como ahora no le falta el dinero, decidirá comprar el piso de Izaskun (2º A). Para celebrar que ya tienen casa organizarán una fiesta de inauguración a la que los residentes de Mirador de Montepinar están invitados.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un bar con wifi, un hombre con peso y una aprendiz de maruja
programme.desc: Judith se enamora de Aitor, un joven de profundas creencias religiosas. Fermín llama al programa de televisión "Reforma por sorpresa" para remodelar la casa de su hija Lola. Javi, para distraerla, decide preparar una escapada a un hotel rural. Alba y su padre discuten, así que ella se muda al piso de Teodoro. A Amador no le gusta la situación.

programme.title: El Pueblo
programme.desc: Cándido, Arsacio y Ovejas están tristes y aburridos porque Peñafría vuelve a despoblarse. Cuando se aprueba el proyecto de un hotel rural, seis nuevos urbanitas fijan su residencia en la aldea soriana: Cristina y Martín, una pareja de adictos al trabajo dispuestos a pasar un año sabático; Carla y Hugo, dos jóvenes centennials en busca de una vida eco-saludable; y Mariajo, la hermana de Juanjo, y Charles, el novio británico de María. La puesta en marcha del hotel rural, las diversas actividades impulsadas por los urbanitas y la paulatina modernización tecnológica llevarán a Peñafría a vivir una nueva era: la del florecimiento. Celoso del esplendor de la pequeña localidad, Salvador, el alcalde de San Pedro, centro comarcal de las Tierras Altas sorianas, llevará a cabo un estudiado plan para tratar de anexionar Peñafría a su término municipal con oscuras intenciones. Además, el municipio será testigo del regreso de los hippies con un nuevo negocio entre manos y de nuevos romances y triángulos amorosos que tendrán como protagonistas a El Ovejas, cuyo corazón estará dividido entre dos amores; a Nacho, que se replanteará su relación con Balbina; y a Laura, que recobrará la ilusión en el plano sentimental. Consciente de que el amor está en el aire, Cándido albergará el deseo de que nazca el primer peñafriense en cuatro décadas.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un mayorista filántropo, un putero soviético y un agradecido desgraciado
programme.desc: Antonio Recio lucha por no perder la pescadería mientras Amador y Fermín buscan casa. Los planes de boda de Yoli se complican, Maite intenta romper con Alonso y Julia provoca un escándalo familiar con una subasta online.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un santo bilingüe, un topo doble y la vergüenza de los Balmaseda de Unzeta y Téllez-Girón
programme.desc: La tragedia se cierne sobre Berta cuando su madre fallece inesperadamente y descubre una noticia que pone en jaque sus creencias religiosas. Por otra parte, Fermín, Bruno, Menchu y Fina consiguen resolver el inquietante misterio que rodea al hijo muerto de Noelia Balmaseda de Unzeta y Téllez-Girón, la hermana menor de la marquesa Victoria Rafaela. Además, Greta está frente a un gran dilema: ceder a las exigencias de los habitantes del inmueble y abandonar el cargo o seguir luchando por su comunidad.

programme.title: Security
programme.desc: Un ex-soldado trabaja como guardia de seguridad y ahora tiene una nueva misión, debe proteger a una niña de 11 años que corre un grave peligro. La muchacha ha visto algo que no debería, ha sido testigo de un asesinato y por eso se ha convertido en el objetivo de unos peligrosos delincuentes.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Azulejos, un polígrafo y un paquete por correo
programme.desc: Maite es testigo de cómo Eric entrega unos azulejos a Enrique y Araceli. La noticia corre por el edificio y los airados vecinos se quejan a Raquel.

programme.desc: Maite es testigo de cómo Eric entrega unos azulejos a Enrique y Araceli. La noticia corre por el edificio y los airados vecinos se quejan a Raquel.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un anabolicachas, un radar giratorio y una deconstrucción de croqueta
programme.desc: Judith mantendrá una apasionada y tórrida aventura con el apuesto entrenador del gimnasio al que acaba de apuntarse (Octavi Pujades). Mientras, su exmarido, Enrique Pastor, se verá obligado a abordar una espinosa cuestión en el inicio de su legislatura como nuevo alcalde del municipio: el uso de radares con fines recaudatorios. Por su parte, tras ser expulsado del Ático B, Fermín se traslada al apartamento de Vicente para iniciar una nueva vida en común. Sin embargo, las continuas discusiones entre los consuegros amenazan la convivencia. Al mismo tiempo, Amador pone en marcha un arriesgado plan con el que pretende recuperar a sus hijos y ganarse el afecto de su exmujer.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un bodorrio, un león y la revolución de los...
programme.desc: La ruptura entre Araceli y Reyes brinda a Enrique Pastor una oportunidad única: retomar su relación sentimental con su ex-mujer y por este motivo no duda en pedirle matrimonio. Mientras tanto, Judith se ilusiona con Carlos, un antiguo amor de la adolescencia a quien ha contactado a través de una red social. Javi no sabe si continuar su matrimonio con Lola o iniciar un romance con Raquel. Mientras sopesa los pros y los contras de ambas opciones, mantiene la relación con las dos mujeres, situación que se prolonga hasta el momento en el que les comunica su decisión definitiva.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) piensa que su hija Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) está embarazada, y Paz (Melanie Olivares) se siente culpable Desde que comparte con Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) sus sesiones de bingo, Mauricio (Mariano Peña) tiene suerte, así que está encantado de su compañía en el juego, pero Eugenia cree que sus intenciones son otras muy distintas. Jonathan (David Castillo) cumple trabajos sociales acompañando a pasear a un anciano. Su amigo Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) le apoya en la tarea. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) es consciente de que fue él quien le ofreció a Luisma (Paco León) su primer porro, y ahora piensa que por su culpa fue drogadicto. Dicho cargo de conciencia hará que Chema intente recompensarle por el daño hecho.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) se apunta a clases de inglés para mejorar en el curso de secretariado y Mauricio (Mariano Peña) y Chema (Pepe Viyuela) se apuntan también pero con otra motivación distinta Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) y Jonathan (David Castillo) se hacen pasar por un admirador de su abuela, Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso), creando una gran ilusión en ella. Paz (Melanie Olivares) se enamora de un arquitecto y se plantea dejar su actual profesión de prostituta, profesión que el chico desconoce.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Tras una sesión de espiritismo en la que participan Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa), Jonathan (David Castillo), Fidel (Jonathan Castillo), y Luisma (Paco León), éste se entera de que su padre, fallecido, está enfadado con él. Más tarde, Luisma y Fidel quieren repetir la sesión para comprobar dicho enfado. Aída (Carmen Machi) le da mucha a importancia a las decisiones que puedan influír en su vida sentimental

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Paz (Melanie Olivares) le ofrece a su amiga Aída (Carmen Machi) un trabajo en su casa para llevar la limpieza del hogar. Ambas amigas no tardarán en darse cuenta de que no encajan como jefa y empleada Luisma (Paco León) no cesa en su intento de demostrar a Paz que no es su físico por lo que él quiere salir con ella. Los problemas de Mauricio (Mariano Peña) y Chema (Pepe Viyuela) por temas de convivencia van en aumento.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Simón es el nuevo novio de una aristócrata. El programa "Sálvame" difunde unas imágenes de la pareja de vacaciones en Mikonos y Mauricio, Macu, Paz y Eugenia se sorprenden de la gran diferencia de edad entre ambos. Simón le propone a su hermana un encuentro con la duquesa para que se conozcan las familias, pero Paz se niega a colaborar y éste decide utilizar su poder de convicción para conseguir su propósito regalándole joyas de la duquesa y haciéndole ver el dinero del que podrían disponer en el futuro. Paz y la duquesa finalmente se conocen y las cámaras de "Sálvame" se preparan para entrevistar a Simón y a su novia. El joven quiere demostrar ante todo el mundo que su amor es puro y verdadero y le pide a Narcisa, que es como se llama la aristócrata, que se case con él cuando el programa está emitiéndose en directo, delante de Paz Padilla. Por otra parte, Fidel y Germán han inventado una aplicación móvil para conocer la temperatura en otros planetas con la que piensan enriquecerse pero, después de varias horas esperando, constatan que no se ha producido ninguna descarga.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un pipiolo, un bombero y un suicida en el rellano
programme.desc: Un paciente de Judith, abandonado recientemente por su mujer, se queda de okupa en el rellano del tercer piso por dependencia psicológica de su terapeuta. Los vecinos intentan echarle de diferentes modos. Los amigos del bar le dicen a Amador que ahora que está en el paro puede empezar de cero y elegir un trabajo que siempre le haya hecho ilusión. Amador recuerda que de pequeñito soñaba con ser bombero. Lola se queja a Javi de que no es cariñoso con su madre y cuando esté empieza a serlo, Estela malinterpreta sus intenciones. Nines recibe un ultimátum de su prima Raquel: o paga su parte del alquiler, o se va a la calle. Nines empieza a salir con Leo para intentar que la mantenga. Judith descubre que su medio novio yogurín sigue viéndose a escondidas con una ex.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una yaya por sorpresa, una vasectomía y la gran orquesta de Montepinar
programme.desc: La curiosidad innata y un carácter polifacético son las señas de identidad de Héctor (William Miller), rasgos que le han impulsado a abordar diversas disciplinas artísticas. El talento, creatividad y magnetismo de este prometedor artista multidisciplinar es interés de Maite Figueroa, que triunfa como escritora de novela erótica y que desea disfrutar plenamente de sus últimos años de atractivo. Tras su primer encuentro, ambos vivirán un tórrido romance. Entretanto, Yolanda volcará su energía en formar su propia familia, ya que está firmemente convencida de que ha llegado la hora de convertirse en madre, situación que sobrepasa a Amador, padre de tres hijos. Asesorado por los 'leones', el Cuqui se plantea someterse en secreto a una vasectomía. Por otra parte, Vicente, cansado de las continuas presiones de Fermín, decide quitárselo de encima llamando a un programa de televisión para que localicen a Estela Reynolds.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una tanqueta, una eminencia rusa y la madre de todas las derramas
programme.desc: Menchu llega a 'Mirador de Montepinar' para ayudar a su hija Yolanda a preparar la boda. Antonio recibe el premio 'Bogavante de Oro' por su buena gestión de la firma Mariscos Recio. Al mismo tiempo, el empresario sigue empeñado en encontrar un remedio para curar la homosexualidad de su hija Alba. La reparación de una grieta en la estructura del edificio será otros de los temas de los que se ocupará este capítulo.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una resistencia heroica, una catarsis subterránea y un hasta siempre
programme.desc: Ante la inminente expropiación, Recio, autoproclamado líder del movimiento vecinal, comandará la resistencia que contará con el apoyo popular de grupos espontáneos de payasos justicieros. Además, Berta tendrá que decidir si huye a la playa con Fermín o se queda junto a su marido. Mientras, Fina consigue escapar de su cautiverio en el búnker nuclear. Por otra parte, Irene y Maite descubren el doble juego de Amador y el Cuqui, atemorizado por la idea de quedarse solo, se plantea acabar con su vida.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un mayorista reinsertado, un portero octogenario y un edificio señorial
programme.desc: Antonio Recio recupera su libertad tras cumplir condena y pagar su deuda con la sociedad. Su esposa, Berta, será la encargada de ponerlo al día, aunque para Recio será un shock conocer su nueva vivienda y a sus vecinos. Mientras, Amador, arruinado tras gastar el dinero de la expropiación, lucha por seguir adelante trabajando pluriempleado y realizando actividades de lo más variopintas. Además, Fermín ayudará a Bruno a descubrir el secreto de su vecina de enfrente, una mujer misteriosa con un pasado inquietante.

programme.title: El tren de las 3:10
programme.desc: Arizona, a finales de 1800. El ranchero Dan Evans (Christian Bale), con la esperanza de conseguir una recompensa que alivie sus penurias económicas y así salvar su rancho, decide colaborar en el traslado de un peligroso forajido recién capturado, Ben Wade (Russell Crowe). Dan, veterano del ejército de la Unión, deberá escoltar junto a otros hombres a Wade hasta un pueblo donde pasa el tren de las 3:10, que luego sigue hasta la prisión de Yuma. Pero la misión pronto se volverá muy violenta.

programme.desc: Javi, malaconsejado por Leo, Maxi y Coque, contrata finalmente a un matón, que resulta ser un individuo poco profesional que se equivoca de víctima.
